{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the U-shaped profile
width = 70  # Total width of the profile
height = 40  # Total height of the profile
web_thickness = 5  # Thickness of the web
length = 450  # Length of the profile

# Calculate the dimensions for the blocks
# Main block (web)
web_x = web_thickness
web_y = height
web_z = length

# Flanges (top and bottom)
flange_x = width - web_thickness
flange_y = web_thickness
flange_z = length

# Positions for the blocks
# Web is centered in the width direction
web_x_pos = (width - web_thickness) / 2
web_y_pos = 0
web_z_pos = 0

# Top flange
flange_top_x_pos = 0
flange_top_y_pos = height - web_thickness
flange_top_z_pos = 0

# Bottom flange
flange_bottom_x_pos = 0
flange_bottom_y_pos = 0
flange_bottom_z_pos = 0

# Output the calculated values
{
    "web_x": web_x, "web_y": web_y, "web_z": web_z,
    "flange_x": flange_x, "flange_y": flange_y, "flange_z": flange_z,
    "web_x_pos": web_x_pos, "web_y_pos": web_y_pos, "web_z_pos": web_z_pos,
    "flange_top_x_pos": flange_top_x_pos, "flange_top_y_pos": flange_top_y_pos, "flange_top_z_pos": flange_top_z_pos,
    "flange_bottom_x_pos": flange_bottom_x_pos, "flange_bottom_y_pos": flange_bottom_y_pos, "flange_bottom_z_pos": flange_bottom_z_pos
}"}
